verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party developer stack targets this silicon directly. Xcode builds and tests run on it, with up to 2.1x faster compiles claimed. Metal 4 and the Metal debugger provide shader compilation and pipeline optimization tooling, and Apple ships Apple-silicon-specific frameworks (MLX, PyTorch Metal backends, ML developer pages). One community comment says Unreal Engine game dev is still sluggish, a caveat about third-party engine experience rather than a contradiction of tier-one platform tooling. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on compiler maturity (Clang/LLVM, other toolchains), official CPU-level optimization guidance for M4 Max, and independent hands-on corroboration of the tooling ecosystem.
